runner: research/runners/stable_recal_stop_calibration_record.py (reads the cited artifacts; the rules are typed judgments, the claims are checked)
what: global-stop distributed-overwrite workspace (research/runners/_gnw_distributed_overwrite_workspace_derisk.py, the substrate of webapp/gnw_global_stop.py) re-calibrated by its own rules on the stable integrator (SIM_STABLE_INTEGRATION=1); every value chosen on the isolated organ on dev seeds 7 and 8, never on a reply

seed_roles.reading: dev seeds 7 and 8 are the calibration seeds (every constant was read off them), so the organ gate on 7 and 8 and any whole-brain comparison on them is IN-SAMPLE; the organ gate on 1-6 and 9-15 is out-of-sample for every constant

norm_ws_w.rule: the swap organ's rule, applied to this organ: the largest norm_pool->workspace weight whose sustained single-pattern state reads reliably in the organ's 15-step late window (fraction of windows below half the plateau, steps 100-1000, thal 0, drive 2500, stable). At 16, 8 and 6 every weight 4-10 has windows below half; at 5 only weight 5 has none, with a worst window of ~0.6 of the plateau; at 4 weights 4.5-8 have none and at 6.5 the worst window is 0.80-0.88 of the plateau. At 2 the read is reliable but the neighbouring overlapped pattern is recruited from weight 6.5 (the organ's confident-commit leak). 4 over 5 is the margin judgment the swap made

w_rec.rule: at normalization 4 the sustain knee lies between 4.0 (0.37/0.38 of windows below half) and 4.5 (none); the neighbour is recruited at 10 and not at 8; production is deliberately supra-critical, so 6.5 (~1.44x the knee, inside the reliable and selective band 4.5-8; the swap organ's judgment) was chosen. A judgment, not a formula

thal_tonic_pa.rule: the swap organ's rule: the largest thalamic support with no spontaneous ignition over 1000 undriven steps on both calibration seeds (weight 6.5, normalization 4); 0, 25 and 50 pA stay below the criterion (50 pA: seed 8's pattern 2 reads 0.001 in its last window), 75 pA ignites patterns by themselves on both seeds

solo_plateau.rule: the measured ignited plateau at (6.5, 4) on the stable integrator; the ignition criterion stays IGNITE_FRAC (0.5) x plateau = 0.042, scoped to the stop organ (Rung-2's SOLO_PLATEAU is not touched)

strong_pa.rule: the module's rule STRONG_PA = 2 x IGNITE_PA (the knee): the stable knee by the organ's 45-step read at the re-calibration is 400 pA (300 pA reads 0.037 on seed 7 and 350 pA 0.028 on seed 8, below the 0.042 criterion; 400 pA ignites on both), so 2 x 400

margin_ref.rule: the module's stated rule: MARGIN_REF is 'halfway between single-content and co-ignition'. Its formula SOLO_PLATEAU x 0.5 is that rule evaluated at a co-ignition margin of 0, which held on the old integrator (conflict margin exactly 0 in the lockstep runaway) and does not hold on valid membranes (three-content conflict 0.0267 / 0.0351, max 0.0468 > 0.042). So the midpoint of the two measured levels (confident and three-content conflict, the gate's conflict, pooled over the calibration seeds) = 0.057. Decided BEFORE the organ gate ran; the literal formula (0.042) was run through the gate alongside as a comparison arm

boost_scale.rule: the module's rule: the boost at a full conflict lies inside the window where the intact workspace clears and the normalization-lesioned one does not (production: ~0.13 inside [0.09, 0.15]). On valid membranes (fixed boost, 8 trials per boost, both calibration seeds, three and two held contents) the intact workspace clears on every trial at 0.6, 0.8, 1, with a non-monotone dip at 0.25-0.5; the lesion never clears up to 1.0 (U >= 1 empties x per spike, so a larger boost is the same). Target = 0.8, the middle of the robust band 0.6-1.0 (a judgment), at the full-conflict deficit margin_ref - conflict = 0.0261: 0.8 / 0.0261 = 30.7, rounded to 31

unchanged.rule: geometry, the depression's time constant, the pulse, the noise and the read windows are not constants of the runaway; nothing measured here asks for them to move

organ_go_gate.reading: at the re-calibration the organ's GO holds on 5 of 15 dev seeds (1, 3, 5, 7, 10). The capability itself (a co-ignited conflict driven to n_ignited 0 by the conflict-gated depression) holds on 11 of 15; selectivity, normalization load-bearing, byte-identity and determinism on 15 of 15. The dominant failure is not the stop: the anti-cheats that need the three-content conflict to HOLD without the stop (freeze, scramble, conflict-off) pass on 7 of 15, because on valid membranes the divisively normalized workspace resolves a three-way co-ignition to one pattern by itself within ~250 steps; on the old integrator the lockstep runaway made every co-ignited pattern self-sufficient. The remaining stop failures are the sensor: a conflict that reads a margin near or above margin_ref gets a boost in the 0.25-0.5 dip or none (seeds 2, 9, 12; seed 6 starts with one pattern). With the two contents production usually holds, every conflict check passes on 15 of 15 (supplementary, not the gate). No constant was re-derived after the gate ran

order_of_events: all constants were fixed from the cited sweeps (curve, inhibition, sustain, thal, knee, window, margins) before the organ gate ran; margin_ref's midpoint reading and the literal-formula comparison arm were both fixed before. The gate first ran at 16:13 (its sidecars read git_dirty because a test helper was being edited meanwhile) and was re-run from clean commits only to re-stamp provenance (16:18-16:19, in waves with the outputs committed between them); the results are byte-identical across the runs, and no constant was changed after the gate
